reason: I already order from my Instagram page and I know how it works with them. Paying on delivery the first time is nice, but I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox something from Baghdad Express, so I'd wait.
objection: 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is almost the price again, and my usual page already gives me a total price without me doing kilo maths. And I don't know anyone who has used them.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a TikTok creator I follow showing a real order arriving, with the total they paid and the photos matching.
